excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Bao Yonggang  Editor: Lin Juemin  
Midwinter in Beijing carries a slight chill, but the venue of Moore Threads' first developer conference (MDC) was buzzing with energy. The 1,000-square-meter exhibition area gathered over a thousand developers, who focused on cutting-edge technologies like intelligent robots, digital humans, and Agents, while also discussing advanced applications such as AI for Science and weather prediction.  
The digital entertainment and video multimedia zone at the center of the exhibition area was the most eye-catching: some were immersed in controlling the eVTOL full-motion flight simulator, while others were engaged in intense battles in classic fighting games like King of Fighters and AAA titles powered by domestic GPUs. "We might be the only ones in China currently capable of showcasing Street Fighter games," an engineer noted, highlighting Moore Threads' rarity in possessing graphical capabilities alongside AI computing power among its peers.  
Merely learning about Moore Threads—one of the few domestic companies developing full-feature GPUs—through text or videos might only offer a vague idea. Being at the exhibition, with ten GPU application cases displayed at once, was enough to convey part of the GPU's value. But when nearly a hundred applications were showcased simultaneously, the impact was twofold: on one hand, it provided an intuitive sense of the capabilities of a full-feature GPU; on the other, all these applications came from a domestic GPU company founded just five years ago.  
Moore Threads translates the capabilities of its full-feature GPU into a wide range of applications spanning from consumer to vertical industries, and from graphics to AI and high-performance computing. This not only concretely demonstrates its unique value but also offers a tangible sense of its impact.
excerpt_i18n.es:
Autor｜Bao Yonggang Editor｜Lin Juemin  
A mediados del invierno, Pekín tiene un ligero frío, pero en el recinto de la primera Conferencia de Desarrolladores de Moore Thread (MDC) el ambiente es muy cálido. En una zona de exposición de 1.000 metros cuadrados se reúnen más de mil desarrolladores, interesados en tecnologías de vanguardia como robots inteligentes, humanos digitales y agentes, y también debaten sobre aplicaciones avanzadas como IA para la ciencia y predicción meteorológica.  
La zona central de entretenimiento digital y multimedia es la más llamativa: algunos se sumergen en la experiencia de control del simulador de vuelo completo eVTOL, mientras otros libran intensas batallas en mundos de juegos clásicos como King of Fighters y títulos AAA impulsados por GPU nacionales. "Actualmente, quizás solo yo puedo mostrar juegos como Street Fighter en el país".

items.title: Omdia发布《2025全球企业级MaaS市场分析》，火山引擎名列全球第三
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，国际市场调研机构英富曼（Omdia）发布了《2025全球企业级MaaS市场分析》报告：截至2025年10月，OpenAI和Google Cloud分别以近70万亿和43万亿的日均Tokens调用量，排名全球MaaS服务市场前两位。中国云厂商火山引擎日均Tokens调用量超30万亿，名列全球第三，市场份额达到15%。三家厂商合计占据全球MaaS市场65%的份额。 当前，MaaS服务已成为增长最快、毛利最高的AI云计算产品。火山引擎最新数据显示，截至今年12月，豆包大模型日均调用量已突破50万亿Tokens，比10月数据增长66.7%，相比去年同期更是增长超十倍。通过模型结构和软硬件工程优化等技术创新，大模型在提供极高性价比服务的同时也有着较好的毛利。据火山引擎总裁谭待透露，豆包大模型MaaS的毛利水平远远优于IaaS等传统云产品。 头部模型厂商不断推陈出新，重点发力多模态和Agent能力，从而解锁了更多应用场景。以最新旗舰模型为例，GPT-5.2、Gemini 3.0 和豆包 1.8 均为多模态大模型，原生支持图像等视觉理解，并通过强化工具调用和多轮指令遵循等能力，进一步拓展了在具身智能、智能硬件、产品质检、软件服务等应用场景，为终端用户带来了更好的使用体验。 在常见的客服场景中，早期大模型只能实现更具拟人感的AI对话，现在AI客服则可以直接给客户推荐心仪的购物链接、自主完成工单客诉等一系列Agent任务。相应地，消费者购物体验也变得更好，带动模型Tokens调用量成倍增长。 图像和视频创作模型也是今年全球MaaS市场的一大亮点，真正达到生产级应用水平。尤其是Nano Banano和豆包Seedream4.0的推出，让短剧、漫剧、PPT制作、海报制作门槛大幅降低，惠及更广泛的人群。 Omdia指出，模型厂商和云厂商正在加速模型迭代，并完善A

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the international market research firm Omdia released the "2025 Global Enterprise MaaS Market Analysis" report: as of October 2025, OpenAI and Google Cloud ranked first and second in the global MaaS service market, with daily token calls of nearly 70 trillion and 43 trillion, respectively. Chinese cloud provider Volcano Engine, with over 30 trillion daily token calls, placed third globally, capturing a 15% market share. Together, these three providers account for 65% of the global MaaS market. Currently, MaaS services have become the fastest-growing and highest-margin AI cloud computing product. Latest data from Volcano Engine shows that as of December this year, the daily call volume for the Doubao large model has exceeded 50 trillion tokens, a 66.7% increase from October and more than tenfold growth compared to the same period last year. Through technological innovations such as model architecture and software-hardware engineering optimizations, large models offer highly cost-effective services while maintaining strong margins. According to Tan Dai, President of Volcano Engine, the margin level of Doubao's large model MaaS far surpasses that of traditional cloud products like IaaS. Leading model providers continue to innovate, focusing on multimodal and Agent capabilities, thereby unlocking more application scenarios. Taking the latest flagship models as examples, GPT-5.2, Gemini 3.0, and Doubao 1.8 are all multimodal large models, natively supporting visual understanding such as images, and enhancing tool invocation and multi-turn interactions.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la firma internacional de investigación de mercados Omdia publicó el informe "Análisis del mercado global de MaaS empresarial 2025": hasta octubre de 2025, OpenAI y Google Cloud ocuparon los dos primeros puestos en el mercado global de servicios MaaS, con volúmenes diarios de llamadas de tokens de casi 70 billones y 43 billones, respectivamente. El proveedor chino de servicios en la nube, Volcano Engine, superó los 30 billones de tokens diarios, situándose en tercer lugar a nivel mundial, con una cuota de mercado del 15%. En conjunto, estos tres proveedores representan el 65% del mercado global de MaaS. items.raw_excerpt: 2025年12月12-13日，第八届GAIR全球人工智能与机器人大会在深圳·博林天瑞喜来登酒店正式启幕。 作为AI 产学研投界的标杆盛会，GAIR自2016年创办以来，始终坚守“传承+创新”内核，始终致力于连接技术前沿与产业实践。 在人工智能逐步成为国家竞争核心变量的当下，算力正以前所未有的速度重塑技术路径与产业结构。13日举办的「AI 算力新十年」专场聚焦智能体系的底层核心——算力，从架构演进、生态构建到产业化落地展开系统讨论，试图为未来十年的中国AI产业，厘清关键变量与发展方向。 并行科技副总裁、AI联合创始人赵鸿冰在「AI 算力新十年」论坛发表了主题为《基于用户视角的算力服务及算网服务》的演讲。 历经18年超算领域深耕，并行科技见证并参与了中国算力市场的演进。当前，算力市场呈现多场景、多业态的爆发式增长，从尖端超算到智算形态，从算力租赁到算力网络，行业生态日趋多元；与此同时，大模型技术的快速迭代，也对算力的可用性、高效性与性价比提出了更高要求。 在这样的背景下，从用户视角构建算力服务体系、通过算力网络实现资源的高效整合与调度，以及应对推理需求爆发带来的产业变革，成为算力行业亟待解决的核心问题。 赵鸿冰在演讲中指出，当前算力市场已形成四大核心业态：算力租赁作为最基础的形态，以“裸金属”算力资源长期交付用户且不参与后续应用；算力服务聚焦用户终端需求的“最后一公里”，核心是按需提供精准适配业务场景的算力支持；算力运营则依靠复杂调度平台统筹管理资源，实现算力的高效分配与运营；而算力网络作为更高维度的形态，通过纳管多个算力平台形成广泛覆盖的网络，达成跨平台整体调度。 为此，并行科技推出“厂网结合”模式：“厂”即公司投入大量资金建设的万卡集群等重资产布局，“网”则是通过轻资产扩张连接国内47个智算中心与15个超算中心，该算力网络可调度200万CPU核心、5万多张GPU卡，服务超1

excerpt_i18n.en: On December 12-13, 2025, the 8th GAIR Global Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Summit officially commenced at the Sheraton Shenzhen Boao Tianrui Hotel. As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment community, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice. With artificial intelligence increasingly becoming a core variable in national competition, computing power is reshaping technological pathways and industrial structures at an unprecedented pace. The "AI Computing Power in the Next Decade" session held on the 13th focused on computing power—the foundational core of intelligent systems—engaging in systematic discussions from architectural evolution and ecosystem development to industrial implementation, aiming to clarify key variables and development directions for China's AI industry over the next ten years. At the "AI Computing Power in the Next Decade" forum, Zhao Hongbing, Vice President and AI Co-founder of Parallel Technology, delivered a keynote speech titled "Computing Power Services and Computing Network Services from a User Perspective." With 18 years of deep expertise in the supercomputing field, Parallel Technology has witnessed and participated in the evolution of China's computing power market. Currently, the computing power market is experiencing explosive growth across multiple scenarios and business models, ranging from cutting-edge supercomputing to intelligent computing forms, and from computing power leasing to computing power networks, making the industry ecosystem increasingly diverse. Simultaneously, the rapid iteration of large-scale model technology imposes higher demands on the availability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness of computing power. Against this backdrop, constructing a computing power service system from a user perspective, achieving efficient integration and scheduling of resources through computing power networks, and addressing the industrial transformation driven by the surge in inference demand have become urgent challenges for the computing power industry.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los días 12 y 13 de diciembre de 2025, se inauguró oficialmente la octava Conferencia Global de Inteligencia Artificial y Robótica (GAIR) en el Sheraton Shenzhen Bo Lin Tian Rui Hotel. Como evento de referencia en el ámbito de la investigación, la educación, la industria y la inversión en IA, GAIR, desde su creación en 2016, siempre se ha adherido al núcleo de "herencia + innovación", dedicándose a conectar la vanguardia tecnológica con la práctica industrial. En un momento en que la inteligencia artificial se está convirtiendo gradualmente en una variable central de la competencia nacional, la potencia de cálculo está remodelando las rutas tecnológicas y las estructuras industriales a una velocidad sin precedentes.
